topic_relevance.basis: Arithmetic q-van der Corput and exponent triples are a method-adjacent source for N03. The addendum details parent(9.14), supplies divisor/gcd bookkeeping, and does not prove Euclidean oscillatory integral or private half-density results.

definitions: This is explicitly a detailed proof of parent inequality(9.14); it does not announce an erratum.

theorem_cards.label: Lemma1.2
assumptions: Integer q≥1; real x≥1; τ(q) is the positive divisor count.
proof_steps: Group n by d=gcd(n,q), count at most floor(x/d) multiples for each d|q, sum d floor(x/d)≤xτ(q).
theorem_cards.checked_derivation: Independent divisor partition proves the stated inequality including endpoints.

theorem_cards.label: Lemma1.3
assumptions: m is a positive squarefree integer; s≥1 integer.
proof_steps: Compare each prime valuation. For v_p(s)=0,1 no contribution above exponent2. For v_p(s)=2, a squarefree m can raise exponent to3 and s‡ supplies p³. For v_p(s)≥3, ν+1≤4ν/3. Multiply.
theorem_cards.checked_derivation: All prime-valuation cases independently derived; PDF p2 formula visually checked.
